QuestInfo.name: [Collector's Request] Sayram's Traces
QuestInfo.0: You travel to Leafre and meet Chief Tatamo. Will he know more?
QuestInfo.1: Tatamo says Sayram participated in the #bwar 300 years ago#k. When you hand him the book about Sayram's legend, he recognizes Sayram's ally, the Magician #bAurelia#k. She went on to become the #bteacher of Alcaster#k, a Magician in El Nath.
QuestInfo.2: You went to #bEl Nath#k and met #bAlcaster#k. What will he know?

0.0: You want to know about a fella named '#bSayram#k'? That name sounds awfully familiar... Oh!
0.1: I'm surprised you'd know about someone that ancient. After all, he was involved in the #bwar 300 years ago#k.
0.2: When I was but a lad, the adults told me his tale as their parents had told them. But all that's remembered here is that Sayram used his strength to protect Leafre from danger.
0.3: Not sure why'd you'd come here to learn about him, though.
0.4: What's that you've got there? A book about Sayram? Let me take a gander and see if it clears any cobwebs out of this ol' noggin of mine...
0.5: Ah, yes. You may find this interesting. The adults once told me of Sayram's ally, an #belegant Magician#k. Supposedly she #bdied during the war 300 year ago#k.
0.6: Come to think of it, she had a #bstudent#k. Oh, what was the name...? Al... Alca...
0.8: Don't know how that geezer is still kicking, but he ought to still be in El Nath. Though, I guess this old pot is calling the kettle black. Hahaha.\r\n#b#e(Accept to move to the next quest location.)#n#k

0.msg: Hurry on over. He might know more than me. I'll send you to El Nath right away.

1.0: Hello. What brings you to El Nath?
